visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens on the exterior of a small, white one-story house with bright blue window frames, situated under the shade of a massive tree adorned with large staghorn ferns. A red brick pathway leads toward the building, surrounded by white gravel and small potted plants in the bright daylight. (2) A transition shows the cafe's interior through a dark ceiling lattice, revealing a cozy space filled with hanging vines and tropical plants. Wooden dining tables and chairs are scattered throughout the room, creating an indoor forest atmosphere with soft, warm lighting. (3) The camera moves through the dining area, showcasing a variety of seating including a wooden table and chairs and a colorful floral-patterned armchair. Botanical art hangs on the walls, and large windows allow natural light to illuminate the lush green interior decor. (4) A slow pan focuses on a white wall decorated with two framed plant illustrations and a bamboo blind partially covering a window. A leafy plant in the foreground frames the scene, emphasizing the calm, nature-inspired setting of the room. (5) A close-up shot features a large wooden platter filled with food, including a toasted bagel, two sausages, a hash brown, a boiled egg, and a small glass of yogurt with salad. Two hands enter the frame to pull apart the warm bagel, revealing its soft texture. (6) The camera shifts to a close-up of a bowl of salmon fried rice topped with a generous amount of shredded seaweed and fried bits. A metal spoon scoops up a portion of the rice, showing the steam and the mixture of ingredients. (7) Two waffles on sticks, served in glass cups with a white base, are held up and shown to the camera. The hand rotates one of the waffles to show the golden-brown grid pattern and the powdered sugar topping. (8) A close-up reveals a thin slice of tea-flavored mille-feuille cake topped with a green leaf-shaped chocolate. A fork cuts through the many fine layers of the cake, highlighting its delicate and creamy construction on a white plate. (9) Liquid milk tea is poured from a white ceramic teapot decorated with colorful floral and rabbit patterns into a matching cup. The creamy brown tea flows steadily in the center of the frame against a tray with other small dishes. (10) The final sequence shows an outdoor wicker bench placed in a white gravel garden area surrounded by large monstera leaves and other tropical plants. The video ends with a shot of the cafe's exterior and a text overlay providing the shop's name and address.
